title: Microsoft Entra ID, Identities and Hybrid Identity

header.html: Describe Microsoft Entra ID; Describe types of identities, including workload identities; Describe hybrid identity
the official SC-900 study guide, skills measured as of October 21, 2026

toc.title: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra ID

html:
1Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra ID

Microsoft Entra is the family of Microsoft identity and network access products. Microsoft Entra ID is the cloud-based identity and access management service: it stores identities and signs people in to Azure, Microsoft 365 and thousands of other apps. Old name It was called Azure Active Directory (Azure AD).

Piece Meaning
Tenant A dedicated instance of Microsoft Entra ID for an organization
Users, groups, devices, apps The objects stored in the tenant
Single sign-on (SSO) Sign in once, reach many apps
Licenses Free (core features), P1 and P2 (more features), plus Microsoft Entra ID Governance [Verify live]

Entra ID provides authentication (sign-in, MFA), access management (Conditional Access, roles) and identity protection and governance (modules 4–6).

Exam tip

. Entra ID = the cloud identity service (formerly Azure AD). It is not a cloud version of Windows domain controllers; that is a different service (Microsoft Entra Domain Services). Microsoft Entra is the name of the whole family.

2Types of identities

Identity type What it is Examples
User (member) A person inside the organization An employee
External user (guest) A person outside the organization invited to collaborate A partner, a contractor
Group A set of users managed together A security group
Device identity A computer or phone registered or joined to Entra A laptop
Workload identity An identity for software, not a person An app, a script, a service

Workload identities

A workload identity lets an application, service or script authenticate and access resources without a person.

Kind Meaning
Application (app registration) The definition of an app in Entra ID
Service principal The identity of the app in a tenant; used to get access
Managed identity An identity managed automatically by Azure for an Azure resource: no credentials to store or rotate

Managed identity types: system-assigned (tied to one resource, deleted with it) and user-assigned (a separate resource that can be shared by several).

Device identities

State Meaning
Microsoft Entra registered Personal or BYOD device registered
Microsoft Entra joined Organization-owned device joined to the cloud
Microsoft Entra hybrid joined Device joined to both on-premises AD and Entra ID

Exam tip

. A workload identity belongs to software. A managed identity is the best choice for an Azure resource that needs access, because it needs no secrets. System-assigned = lifecycle tied to the resource; user-assigned = reusable.

3Hybrid identity

Hybrid identity means one identity that works for both on-premises and cloud resources. Organizations that already use Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) synchronize their identities to Microsoft Entra ID.

Tool Purpose
Microsoft Entra Connect Synchronizes on-premises AD DS identities to Entra ID
Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync A lightweight, cloud-managed agent for sync

Sign-in methods for hybrid identity

Method How sign-in is checked
Password hash synchronization A hash of the password hash is synced to Entra ID; the cloud validates sign-in
Pass-through authentication Entra ID passes the sign-in to an on-premises agent that checks AD DS
Federation (for example AD FS) Sign-in is redirected to an on-premises federation service

Users get one set of credentials and SSO across cloud and on-premises apps.

Exam tip

. Hybrid identity = on-premises AD synchronized to Entra ID. The tool is Entra Connect (or Cloud Sync). Password hash sync is the simplest; pass-through keeps checks on-premises; federation uses a separate federation service.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants an Azure web app to read a storage account without storing a password in code. Which identity is the best choice?

  • AA managed identity
  • BA guest user
  • CA shared administrator account
  • DA device identity
Show the answer

Answer: A. A managed identity gives an Azure resource an identity with no credentials to manage.

S2A contractor from another company needs access to one Fabrikam app. Which identity type represents the contractor?

  • AExternal user (guest)
  • BWorkload identity
  • CService principal
  • DManaged identity
Show the answer

Answer: A. A person outside the organization invited to collaborate is an external (guest) user.

S3Which tool synchronizes on-premises Active Directory identities to Microsoft Entra ID?

  • AMicrosoft Entra Connect
  • BAzure Firewall
  • CAzure Bastion
  • DMicrosoft Purview
Show the answer

Answer: A. Microsoft Entra Connect (or Cloud Sync) provides the synchronization for hybrid identity.

S4A managed identity is tied to one virtual machine and is deleted when the VM is deleted. Which type is it?

  • AUser-assigned, created as a separate resource
  • BSystem-assigned
  • CFederated through an identity provider
  • DGuest invited from another organization
Show the answer

Answer: B. A system-assigned managed identity shares the lifecycle of its resource.

S5Microsoft Entra ID was previously known by which name?

  • AMicrosoft Defender XDR
  • BAzure Policy
  • CAzure Active Directory
  • DMicrosoft Sentinel
Show the answer

Answer: C. Azure Active Directory was renamed Microsoft Entra ID.

S6An organization wants sign-in to be checked by an on-premises agent that queries Active Directory. Which method fits?

  • APassword hash synchronization
  • BPass-through authentication
  • CManaged identity
  • DGuest invitation
Show the answer

Answer: B. Pass-through authentication validates sign-in against on-premises AD DS through an agent.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What was Microsoft Entra ID called before?

Show the answer

Azure Active Directory (Azure AD).

R2What is a workload identity?

Show the answer

An identity for software, such as an app, service or script.

R3Name the two managed identity types.

Show the answer

System-assigned and user-assigned.

R4What does hybrid identity mean?

Show the answer

One identity that works for both on-premises and cloud resources.

R5Which tool synchronizes AD DS to Entra ID?

Show the answer

Microsoft Entra Connect (or Entra Cloud Sync).

R6Name the three device identity states.

Show the answer

Registered, joined and hybrid joined.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Entra ID cloud identity and access management (formerly Azure AD); tenant; Free, P1, P2, ID Governance
Identity types users (members), external guests, groups, device identities, workload identities
Workload identities app registration, service principal, managed identity (system-assigned or user-assigned; no secrets)
Hybrid identity Entra Connect or Cloud Sync; password hash sync, pass-through authentication, federation (AD FS)
